item.title: Death toll from Israeli strikes on Lebanon passes 3,000, officials say
item.description: It marks a grim milestone in the conflict between Israel and the Lebanese armed group Hezbollah since March, despite a nominal ceasefire.

item.title: Trump says he called off new Iran attack at request of Gulf states
item.description: The US president says he is holding off on an attack planned for Tuesday as "serious negotiations are now taking place".

item.title: More die of suspected Ebola as WHO warns that numbers will rise further
item.description: In its latest update, the World Health Organization says there have now been 139 suspected deaths and 600 cases.

item.title: Ebola outbreak may be spreading faster than first thought, WHO doctor warns
item.description: Hundreds of cases are suspected in central Africa but experts fear the actual number may be much higher.
